purpose: 14 mm validation session at the 15 V operating point (2026-09-24). Stiffness checks, two w-field scans, and the heart / cardioid designs supplied by the analysis side in G:/Experiment/20260923/measurement_plan/ff_heart_15V. Run names are shortened so that the run directory keeps the _V15 tag under the Windows path budget; the full design name is kept in feedforward_design.design.

experiments.name: kcheck_x_S105_6jumps
experiments.note: Stiffness check for the 15 V session: x steps 0 -> +1.05 -> 0 -> -1.05 -> 0 -> +1.05 -> 0 mm, 7 holds of 2.0 s, 6 jumps, 14.0 s. Same command as the ff_heart_20260918 kcheck so the 18 V and 15 V stiffness values compare directly.

experiments.name: kcheck_y_S105_6jumps
experiments.note: Stiffness check for the 15 V session: y steps 0 -> +1.05 -> 0 -> -1.05 -> 0 -> +1.05 -> 0 mm, 7 holds of 2.0 s, 6 jumps, 14.0 s. Same command as the ff_heart_20260918 kcheck so the 18 V and 15 V stiffness values compare directly.

experiments.name: kcheck_z_S105_6jumps
experiments.note: Stiffness check for the 15 V session: z steps 0 -> +1.05 -> 0 -> -1.05 -> 0 -> +1.05 -> 0 mm, 7 holds of 2.0 s, 6 jumps, 14.0 s. Same command as the ff_heart_20260918 kcheck so the 18 V and 15 V stiffness values compare directly.

experiments.name: wscan_XZ_a
experiments.note: Surface scan of the equilibrium-shift field w at 15 V: spiral centre -> 9.2 mm -> centre in the XZ plane (y = 0), counter-clockwise, 1.5 turns/s, 14 s, no compensation (u = r). Recorded twice per session, at least 40 minutes apart, to check how far the field moves while the boards stay at their operating point.

experiments.name: wscan_XZ_b
experiments.note: Surface scan of the equilibrium-shift field w at 15 V: spiral centre -> 9.2 mm -> centre in the XZ plane (y = 0), clockwise, 1.5 turns/s, 14 s, no compensation (u = r). Recorded twice per session, at least 40 minutes apart, to check how far the field moves while the boards stay at their operating point.
